custom-devices.label: Linux Instance 1
runDebug: if [ -d app ]; then BIN=$(pwd)/app/build/linux/x64/debug/bundle/lift; TMP=$(pwd)/.tmp/linux-1; else BIN=$(pwd)/build/linux/x64/debug/bundle/lift; TMP=$(pwd)/../.tmp/linux-1; fi; XDG_DATA_HOME=$TMP $BIN --dart-define=INSTANCE=1
